name: Organiser's area
description: A part of the app at /organiser that only someone with the passcode can open, with a sign-in page and signing out.
fits: Add it when only the person running the app should see or change something, such as changing a rota or seeing everyone's details.

secrets.name: ORGANISER_PASSCODE
secrets.reason: The passcode that opens your app's organiser's area. Anyone who has it can see and change what's there, so choose one that's hard to guess. Changing it signs everyone out.

edits: In the Worker's main module (main in wrangler.jsonc), import `organiser` from `./organiser` (`./server/organiser` from src/index.ts), add the organiser's own routes to it as its notes say, then mount it after them: `app.route("/organiser", organiser);`.
If the app has a front end (index.html), add "/organiser/sign-in" and "/organiser/api/*" to `run_worker_first` in wrangler.jsonc's `assets`, so the Worker answers them rather than the front end.
